newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa Sec sees large net loss for 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Sec sees large net loss for 96/97.

text.p: Daiwa Securities Co Ltd said on Monday that it was sure that it would post a large net loss for the year to March 31, but it did not give a specific forecast.
"It is unavoidable that we will post a large net loss and we will cancel our original plan to use reserves for coping with losses," Daiwa Securities said in a statement.
Daiwa said that due to a sharp fall in share prices in recent months, it cannot expect a sharp rise in its business and cannot raise a large profit from securities sales.
It said it would announce a specific earnings forecast for 1996/97 as soon as possible.
Previously, Daiwa had said it would provide 120 billion yen in support to its finance unit and it would include an extraordinary loss of the same amount in its 1996/97 earnings.
Daiwa had also said it would try not to post a net loss in 1996/97 by selling some holding securities and using reserves.
